Instant control. Infinite creativity. 
 Unlock your creative potential with the Razer Stream Controller X. Designed to simplify your streaming and content creation process, this controller puts instant control and infinite creativity right at your fingertips. No more juggling multiple devices or struggling with complex setups. With the Stream Controller X, you can streamline your workflow and focus on engaging your fans and growing your following. 

 Control at your fingertips. 
 The controller features 15 Switchblade Buttons, which you can customize to create handy shortcuts for various tasks. Whether it's streaming, video editing, music production, or controlling your apps and lights, you can easily access and control them with just a few taps. The customizable icons and intuitive visual navigation make it effortless to find and activate the functions you need. 

 Automate your process. 
 Take automation to the next level with Multi-link Macros. By linking multiple actions to a single button, you can execute complex tasks with a simple press. Kickstart your stream, trigger simultaneous actions, or set up sequential operations—all at the push of a key. This feature saves you time and effort, allowing you to focus on delivering top-notch content. 

 Designed for efficient multi-tasking. 
 Efficient multi-tasking is made possible with the Stream Controller X's intuitive navigation and organization. You can sort and store as many actions as you want within a single button, creating custom profiles for different tasks. With Dynamic Mode enabled, the controller can automatically switch profiles based on the detected app, ensuring seamless transitions and optimized performance. 

 Compatible with leading streaming software 
 The Stream Controller X is compatible with leading streaming software, thanks to its partnership with Loupedeck Software. Get set up instantly with ready-made profiles for streaming, content creation, productivity, and more. The controller supports essential tools like Twitch, OBS Studio, Spotify, Razer Key Light Control, Razer Audio Mixer Control, and Voicemod. With the endless options available, you can tailor your setup to suit your specific needs and preferences. 

 Optimal viewing angel 
 Enjoy an optimal viewing angle during your streaming sessions with the detachable 50° Anti-slip Magnetic Stand. Simply snap on the controller for a secure fit that not only provides you with a clear view of all your buttons but also stays firmly in place during intense use, thanks to its grippy underside. 

 Compatible with leading streaming software Setting up your Stream Controller X is a breeze. Powered by Loupedeck, the controller offers an all-in-one setup experience via the Loupedeck marketplace. Discover a wide range of plugins, profiles, and icon packs that best suit your needs. Easily download and install them directly from the marketplace, ensuring you have all the tools necessary to elevate your streaming and content creation endeavors.

The Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF is one of Intel’s most advanced desktop CPUs, crafted for performance enthusiasts who need raw speed, multitasking power, and precise control. Built on the Raptor Lake Refresh architecture , this 14th Generation processor pushes desktop computing to a new level — blending cutting-edge hybrid technology with massive processing capability.

 🚀 Extreme Hybrid Architecture for Ultimate Speed 

 At its core, the i7-14700KF uses Intel’s powerful hybrid design that combines 8 Performance-cores (P-cores) and 12 Efficient-cores (E-cores) for a total of 20 cores and 28 threads . The Performance-cores deliver incredible single-threaded speed for gaming and demanding workloads, while the Efficient-cores handle background tasks and parallel operations with exceptional energy efficiency.

 With boost frequencies reaching up to 5.6 GHz , the i7-14700KF ensures instant responsiveness, faster load times, and smoother multitasking — whether you’re gaming, editing, streaming, or running professional applications.

 🎮 Designed for Elite Gaming 

 The i7-14700KF is a powerhouse for gaming enthusiasts. With its 20 core hybrid design and high turbo clocks, it delivers exceptional frame rates and low latency across all modern AAA titles. It ensures superior performance in competitive gaming, VR experiences, and high-refresh-rate monitors. Combined with a powerful discrete GPU, it eliminates bottlenecks, providing smooth and consistent gameplay.

 Since this is a KF variant , it does not include integrated graphics , making it perfect for systems that rely entirely on a dedicated GPU for rendering. This configuration allows the CPU to focus all its energy on raw processing performance.

 🧩 Unlocked for Overclocking Freedom 

 As an unlocked processor , the i7-14700KF gives you full control to customize your system’s performance. Using a compatible motherboard (Z690, Z790, or later), enthusiasts can tweak multipliers, voltages, and frequencies to achieve optimal performance. When paired with high-quality cooling, such as liquid cooling or advanced air solutions, the i7-14700KF can maintain incredible stability even when pushed beyond its rated specifications.

 Intel’s performance-tuning technologies — like Intel® Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) and Thermal Velocity Boost — make it easier to unlock extra speed safely and efficiently.

 💼 Built for Creators and Professionals 

 Beyond gaming, the i7-14700KF is a true workhorse for creators and professionals. Its 20 cores and 28 threads make it a perfect fit for demanding workloads such as video editing, 3D rendering, AI computation, photo editing, and software development . Applications like Adobe Premiere Pro, Blender, and DaVinci Resolve benefit greatly from the processor’s high multi-core performance, while its superior single-core speed ensures quick rendering previews and faster export times.

 Thanks to Intel’s Thread Director technology , tasks are automatically distributed between P-cores and E-cores for maximum efficiency. This smart scheduling guarantees consistent responsiveness even under heavy multitasking conditions.

 ⚙️ Next-Generation Platform Support 

 The Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF supports both DDR5 and DDR4 memory, giving you flexibility to choose between cutting-edge performance or cost-effective configurations.

 DDR5 support up to 5600 MT/s for next-generation speed.

• 
 DDR4 support up to 3200 MT/s for broad compatibility.

 
 Additionally, the processor offers PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 compatibility, enabling ultra-fast data transfer for the latest GPUs and NVMe SSDs. This ensures your system remains future-ready for years to come.

 With a base power (TDP) of 125 W and a maximum turbo power of around 253 W, the i7-14700KF requires robust cooling to perform at its best. A premium air cooler or AIO liquid cooler is highly recommended, especially for overclocking enthusiasts.

 The i9-14900KF carries a 125W processor base power specification and is designed for high-performance desktop workloads. Because this is a KF-series processor , it does not include integrated processor graphics, so graphics output is handled by the dedicated RTX 5070.

 With 24 cores and 32 threads, this processor gives the system substantial resources for gaming while also handling streaming applications, browser tabs, productivity software and demanding multitasking.

 ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB

 Triple-Fan NVIDIA Blackwell Graphics

 Graphics performance is provided by the ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , standard model TUF-RTX5070-12G-GAMING .

 ASUS officially specifies 6,144 CUDA cores , 12GB GDDR7 memory , a 192-bit memory interface and 28Gbps memory speed. The standard model has a default Boost Clock of 2512MHz , while ASUS GPU Tweak III provides an optional 2542MHz OC Mode profile.

 The TUF card uses a large triple-fan design , measures 329 × 140 × 62.5mm , occupies approximately 3.125 slots and uses a single 16-pin power connector. ASUS recommends a 750W PSU for this card.

 This build uses an 850W Gold-rated MSI PSU, providing additional rated capacity above ASUS’s recommendation.

 The RTX 5070 platform supports current NVIDIA RTX technologies including DLSS, ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible games and applications. Actual FPS will always vary according to resolution, graphics settings, driver version and individual game.

 MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI Motherboard

 Z790 DDR5 Platform with PCIe 5.0

 The system is built on the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI , an ATX motherboard based on Intel’s Z790 chipset and LGA1700 socket.

 MSI officially supports compatible 12th, 13th and 14th Generation Intel Core processors , making this motherboard fully compatible with the i9-14900KF.

 The board features four DDR5 DIMM slots with capacity up to 256GB . MSI officially lists DDR5-6000 as a supported overclocked memory speed and supports Intel XMP 3.0 , making it an appropriate platform for the G.SKILL DDR5-6000 memory used in this system.

 For graphics expansion, the main PCIe slot supports PCIe 5.0 x16 directly from the CPU.

 Storage expansion is particularly strong, with four M.2 slots supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 drives plus six SATA 6Gb/s connectors. This gives plenty of room for future SSD upgrades beyond the installed Kingston NV3.

 Networking includes Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 , providing both fast wired and wireless connectivity.
